§6Material Safety§f

§aSome things in this mod will kill you. Here's what to watch for.§f

§6Radiation§f: Accumulates, never decreases naturally. 1000 RAD kills you. §bHazmat armor§f for base protection, §bRad-X§f (+0.2 resistance) early on, §bDecontaminator§f to remove 10 RAD/s. The §bLiquidator Suit§f is the best pre-oil armor.

§6Pyrophoric§f: Ignites when held. Use §bTungsten Reachers§f to handle them safely (they also reduce radiation from held items).

§6Hydroreactive§f: Explodes on contact with water. Don't carry these in rain or near water. No mitigation.

§6Flammable / Explosive§f: Ignites in lava or fire. Flammable + pyrophoric without reachers is a bad time.

§6Blinding§f: Schrabidium causes blindness while held (fades 5s after removal). The FEL with visible-light crystal causes permanent blindness (cure: milk or iodine pill).

§6Digamma§f: Rare radiation from balefire bombs. Treat like normal radiation but with no early-game mitigation.

§cWARNING:§f Read this before you start handling nuclear materials.
